news.title: Celebrating a decade of creativity for 3 Iowa arts buildings
news.summary_en: Ten years ago, three University of Iowa arts buildings opened with great fanfare, marking a major milestone in the university’s recovery from the devastating 2008 flood. Together, the buildings represented more than a return to campus; they sparked a new era for the arts at Iowa.

news.title: Iowa alumna wins 2026 Kirkus Prize
news.summary_en: Author Tayari Jones, who earned a master’s degree in English from the University of Iowa in 1994, has won the 2026 Kirkus Prize for Fiction for her novel Kin.

news.title: Using AI in violence prevention should put survivors first, researcher argues
news.summary_en: A University of Iowa researcher wants social service agencies to establish guidelines for how AI is used. In a new study, Aislinn Conrad recommends that agencies keep people involved in decisions, regularly check AI systems for discrimination, and leverage AI to connect vulnerable people with needed resources and services.
